VB-CABLE THIRD-PARTY NOTICE

VB-CABLE is a separate virtual audio driver produced by VB-Audio Software.
The setup includes the unchanged official base VB-CABLE package, version 2.1.5.8.

Origin and product information: https://vb-cable.com/
VB-Audio licensing and donation information: https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm

VB-CABLE is donationware. Contributions are welcome. The driver is not part of
X-TREME PLAY'S and remains the property of VB-Audio Software. This notice does
not replace the driver's own license included in its original package.

The distribution terms allow embedding the base VB-CABLE package with an
application when users can identify VB-Audio as its source and can donate or
purchase a license. Professional or commercial distribution may require
additional VB-Audio licenses. See the official licensing page above.

X-TREME PLAY'S does not bundle VB-CABLE A+B or VB-CABLE C+D.
